result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M when Garman processes Sparkling’s data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing headings provision and is professionally drafted. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination goes beyond the supplied playbook and is not necessary to achieve the stated position; any post-termination requirement would also be better tailored to claims-made E&O and cyber coverage.
